action:
After a standard system update you need to restart BitlBee to make all the
necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that BitlBee incorrectly handled file transfer
connections that expired when built with libpurple. A remote attacker could
possibly use this issue to cause BitlBee to crash, resulting in a denial of
service, or possibly execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2016-10188)

It was discovered that BitlBee incorrectly handled file transfer requests
for contacts that were not in the contact list. A remote attacker could
possibly use this issue to cause BitlBee to crash, resulting in a denial of
service, or possibly execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2016-10189)
isummary: Several security issues were fixed in BitlBee.
